scope: Curated free/open-source technologies for review; discovery only; no automatic execution, installation, merge, or trust.

required_before_adapter: run static analysis and dependency review

maturity_scale.established: widely deployed, long-lived project or standards-backed ecosystem
maturity_scale.production: production-capable with active maintenance and broad adoption
maturity_scale.emerging: useful but narrower adoption, faster-changing or less proven
maturity_scale.experimental: research/prototype; do not use in boot or security-critical paths

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Nucleus SQL service, Server/Desktop developer bundle, CVEL test fixture
candidates.integration_mode: optional external service or source-reviewed package; never kernel-linked
candidates.review_notes: Permissive license; large dependency and operational surface. Prefer protocol/client integration first.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Hive/Nucleus local metadata, Mobile/Edge embedded state, installer journal
candidates.integration_mode: reviewed vendored library or system package with reproducible build
candidates.review_notes: Excellent fit for offline-first metadata; preserve upstream compile-time hardening and test suite.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Nucleus analytics and ISA/research catalog queries
candidates.integration_mode: user-space plugin or optional command-line tool
candidates.review_notes: Strong local analytics fit; current governance/licensing remains MIT according to the project announcement.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Aurora local inference, CVEL model execution, Edge quantized inference
candidates.integration_mode: sandboxed user-space runtime behind a stable Chimera AI ABI
candidates.review_notes: Large binary/dependency footprint; isolate providers and prohibit arbitrary model execution without provenance.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Offline Aurora assistant and CVEL inference for quantized GGUF models
candidates.integration_mode: optional user-space service with signed model manifest
candidates.review_notes: Good offline fit; model licenses vary independently from runtime license.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Koronos toolchain, Chimera ISA backend research, JIT/plugin infrastructure
candidates.integration_mode: toolchain package; no runtime dependency in boot path
candidates.review_notes: Broad architecture support and reusable IR; pin version and audit bundled third-party components.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: CVEL/JIT for safe bytecode and guest workloads
candidates.integration_mode: sandboxed JIT library behind capability-limited API
candidates.review_notes: Smaller and simpler than LLVM for selected JIT workloads; not a drop-in whole-system compiler.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Server/CVEL distributed experimentation and model pipelines
candidates.integration_mode: external orchestrated service; not part of base OS
candidates.review_notes: Useful for research clusters but heavyweight; keep out of minimal Desktop/Mobile images.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Server analytics workload profile and Nucleus batch jobs
candidates.integration_mode: optional cluster integration via connectors
candidates.review_notes: Mature but JVM-heavy and operationally complex; adapter only, not embedded.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Compiler/runtime support for numeric and image workloads
candidates.integration_mode: toolchain/runtime package with explicit license inventory
candidates.review_notes: Prefer LLVM or GCC runtime shipped by the selected toolchain; track exact runtime license text.

candidates.license: LGPL-2.1 for core components (component-specific review required)
candidates.adapter_opportunity: Server object/block/file storage backend and CVEL cluster lab
candidates.integration_mode: external storage adapter; no bundled daemon in default ISO
candidates.review_notes: Powerful but complex; integrate by S3/RBD/CephFS protocols after security review.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Server storage profile, snapshot/replication tooling
candidates.integration_mode: optional kernel module/userland only where license and kernel policy permit
candidates.review_notes: Do not assume direct kernel inclusion; preserve CDDL/GPL compatibility review and platform support matrix.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Spotnik observability, policy enforcement, service networking on Linux hosts
candidates.integration_mode: optional host integration; capability detection required
candidates.review_notes: Requires kernel eBPF support and privileged operations; never enable automatically on unknown hosts.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Spotnik routing/SDN lab and Server gateway edition
candidates.integration_mode: optional routing daemon with explicit config review
candidates.review_notes: Strong protocol coverage; treat configuration as privileged and never auto-apply routes.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Spotnik high-speed dataplane experiments and CVEL benchmarking
candidates.integration_mode: optional benchmark/profile, never default runtime
candidates.review_notes: Requires device binding and hugepages; destructive/privileged setup must remain manual.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Edge/IoT firmware SDK and device test harness
candidates.integration_mode: cross-compilation SDK and emulator profile
candidates.review_notes: Good fit for source-level SDK integration; do not flash devices automatically.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Spotnik MQTT bridge, Edge/IoT telemetry, Mobile sync
candidates.integration_mode: optional broker/client package with TLS defaults
candidates.review_notes: Lightweight and suitable from low-power devices to servers; enforce authentication and ACLs.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Kore/Aurora/Nucleus unified traces, metrics, and logs
candidates.integration_mode: stable telemetry ABI/exporter boundary
candidates.review_notes: Best cross-edition observability foundation; keep exporters configurable and local by default.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Server/Edge metrics scrape endpoint and CVEL lab monitoring
candidates.integration_mode: optional service; export Chimera metrics only
candidates.review_notes: Strong ecosystem; avoid hard dependency in base OS.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: TLS for Spotnik/Kore/Aurora and installer transport
candidates.integration_mode: system crypto provider with patch/update discipline
candidates.review_notes: Security-critical; pin supported branch, enable FIPS mode only when applicable, and track CVEs.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Aegis modern crypto, signed manifests, node identity
candidates.integration_mode: small user-space crypto library with narrow API wrapper
candidates.review_notes: Prefer high-level primitives over custom cryptography; preserve secure defaults and key lifecycle review.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: CI provenance/SBOM/vulnerability gates for ISO and packages
candidates.integration_mode: CI-only and offline audit tooling
candidates.review_notes: High-value safe integration because it analyzes artifacts without executing them.

candidates.license: GPL-2.0 for kernel; surrounding components vary
candidates.adapter_opportunity: CVEL high-assurance microkernel research and formal-verification study
candidates.integration_mode: separate research target; no direct Koronos replacement
candidates.review_notes: Excellent for high-assurance research; boundary and license model must be preserved.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: CVEL microVM backend and Server sandbox execution
candidates.integration_mode: external privileged service with explicit host capability checks
candidates.review_notes: Good isolation primitive; treat VM launch and networking as privileged operations.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: CVEL/mobile/edge plugin sandbox and portable applets
candidates.integration_mode: capability-based plugin ABI; deny ambient filesystem/network by default
candidates.review_notes: Strong adapter target for safe extensions when capabilities are explicit.

candidates.adapter_opportunity: Aurora database workspace for Nucleus/PostgreSQL/SQLite/DuckDB
candidates.integration_mode: optional Aurora application/plugin; no privileged access
candidates.review_notes: Potentially useful UI, but smaller/newer project; require source and plugin review before bundling.
